title: SafeOrchestrate: Runtime Checked Intent-Driven Orchestration for Cyber-Physical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.09364v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern cyber physical systems (CPS) integrate heterogeneous sensors, actuators, controllers, and services, composed at runtime rather than at design time. Orchestrating such systems through natural language (NL) is attractive, but unconstrained large language model (LLM) tool use is risky because actions must respect device capabilities, runtime state, and safety constraints. We present Safe Orchestrate, a reference architecture for runtime checked, intent driven CPS orchestration. Given an NL intent, it derives atomic goals, generates a runtime checkable specification for each, grounds the specifications to device affordances, and verifies every candidate action against runtime state and safety constraints before execution. In a Web of Things (WoT) instantiation, the architecture produces Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) style specifications from the NL intent, grounds them to Thing Description (TD) affordances exposed through the Model

translated_title: SafeOrchestrate：面向信息物理系统的运行时校验、意图驱动编排
translated_abstract: 现代信息物理系统（CPS）集成了异构的传感器、执行器、控制器和服务，这些组件在运行时而非设计时进行组合。通过自然语言（NL）来编排此类系统颇具吸引力，但不受约束的大语言模型（LLM）工具使用存在风险，因为动作必须遵循设备能力、运行时状态和安全约束。我们提出了SafeOrchestrate，这是一个用于运行时校验、意图驱动的信息物理系统编排的参考架构。给定一个自然语言意图，它会推导出原子目标，为每个目标生成可在运行时校验的规范，将这些规范落地（ground）到设备可供性上，并在执行前针对运行时状态和安全约束验证每个候选动作。在一个万物网实例化中，该架构从自然语言意图生成线性时序逻辑（LTL）风格的规范，并将其落地到通过模型（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SafeOrchestrate提出了一种运行时校验、意图驱动的信息物理系统编排参考架构，它将自然语言意图转化为可在运行时校验的LTL规范并落地到设备可供性，在执行前对每个候选动作进行运行时状态和安全约束验证，从而降低大语言模型工具使用的风险。
en_tdlr: SafeOrchestrate is a reference architecture for runtime checked, intent-driven CPS orchestration that converts natural language intents into runtime checkable LTL specifications grounded in device affordances and verifies every candidate action against runtime state and safety constraints before execution.
